create_experiment_dockerfile: create an xmanager experiment that packages and runs a Dockerfile-based executable on Vertex AI
run_dockerfile_experiment: run an xmanager launcher script that builds a Docker image and submits a job with environment variables and CLI args
package_dockerfile_executable: package an xm.Dockerfile executable with xm_local.Vertex.Spec executor into an xmanager experiment
add_job_to_experiment: add an xm.Job to an xmanager experiment with executable, executor, env_vars, and args
use_xm_local_vertex_executor: use xm_local.Vertex and xm_local.Vertex.Spec to execute an xmanager job on Google Cloud Vertex AI
